evals.prompt: Audit /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/rasta-company.com/.github/workflows/deploy-image.yml. Convert it to the standard single-image policy: PR validation without push, default-branch/manual publish, lowercase GHCR name, GHA cache, SemVer action refs without SHAs, provenance and SBOM.
evals.expected_output: A corrected single-image workflow and a concise explanation of event, permissions, login, tags, cache, and duplicate-build behavior.
assertions: PR execution does not log in or push while default-branch/manual execution can publish.
Uses complete SemVer action references without SHA or major-only syntax.
Uses lowercase GHCR naming, Buildx, GHA cache, commit/latest tags, provenance, and SBOM.
Does not introduce a second production application build when the Dockerfile owns it.

evals.prompt: Analyze /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/fara-list/.github/workflows/deploy-image.yml and /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/gecut.ir/.github/workflows/deploy.yml. Show how the single-image skill should remove duplicated app builds while retaining lint/typecheck validation and safe GHCR publishing.
evals.expected_output: A comparison and normalized workflow pattern that keeps checks but makes Dockerfile build the production source of truth.
assertions: Finds the application build in both workflows and explains the duplication with the Dockerfiles.
Keeps independent lint/typecheck checks when available but removes redundant production artifact generation.
Uses PR no-push and authorized publish conditions with scoped permissions.
Uses SemVer-only action/tool references and exact cache/tag expectations.

evals.prompt: Review /Users/mm25zamanian/Codes/containers/.github/workflows/publish-container.yml as a multi-image GHCR pipeline. Explain the dependency closure, candidate tags, integration tests, scan/sign/promote sequence, and digest verification, while documenting the SemVer-only reference policy.

evals.prompt: Create a release-ready GitHub Actions workflow for three dependency-ordered images published to GHCR. Pull requests must validate without push; main/manual must build multi-platform candidates, test, scan HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities, sign, promote SemVer aliases plus latest, and verify every alias.
evals.expected_output: A complete multi-image workflow with safe conditions, exact action/tool versions, and promotion gates.
assertions: Builds images in dependency order with unique candidate tags and multi-platform manifests.
Does not push or login from pull requests and scopes permissions to required jobs.
Runs integration, vulnerability scan, signing, promotion, and alias digest verification in that order.
Uses SemVer-only dependency/action/tool references and preserves commit/latest image metadata policy.
